# Hexhaven

> Hexhaven is a free, single-player hex-tile strategy game that runs in the browser. You lay
> hexagonal landscape tiles, farm crops, trade with rival towns and keep bandits away from your
> haven, competing for the highest score against three AI opponents.

## Key facts

- Play: https://hexhaven-game.github.io/hexhaven/ (free, no install, desktop and mobile browsers)
- Genre: cozy hex-tile strategy / city-building, in the spirit of Dorfromantik tile placement with light Catan-style trading
- Modes: single player against three AI opponents
- Tech: three.js (WebGL), Vite, vanilla JavaScript; no backend, saves in localStorage
- Requirements: JavaScript and WebGL
- Source code: https://github.com/hexhaven-game/hexhaven
- Author: Jelle Siderius
- Language: English

## How it plays

Each round you place hexagonal tiles from your hand to extend the landscape. Matching terrain
neighbours score points, crops and buildings produce resources, and the market lets you trade
resources with rival towns. Bandit camps must be cleared with light combat, and quests from the
Haven pay gold for specific deliveries. The game ends after a fixed number of rounds and the
player with the most valuable haven wins.
